decision.observation: In-game view inside the tree above the pool hall: thick brown branches fork in front of the camera; blue pools, checkered deck, yellow railings, palms and the colorful hold-studded mound lie beyond at lower-right. White tiled walkway at left. Hotbar slot 1 (passport) selected. Full stamina. Still unresolved: the rebind screen showed mouse icons for AIM and CLIMB/USE ITEM, while my control reference maps J=climb, K=helping hand.
decision.hypothesis: If K is the climb button (right mouse), holding W+K into the branch should attach me and drain stamina, unlike J which only aimed.
